t: 2-component injection mortar based on vinyl ester for fixing standard applications in cracked concrete and masonry. Expansion-free fixing for small spacings and edge distances. Suitable for use in steelwork constructions, timber constructions, guard rails, façades, staircases, steel brackets, machines, masts, awnings, canopies, gates, consoles, pipelines, gratings and satellite antennae. Processed with the system components Fischer threaded rod FIS A and Fischer internal-threaded anchor RG M I indoors and outside. Temperature resistance of -40°C to 120°C allows for a solid load level, even when subjected to high temperature demands, thus providing great flexibility. Cartridges already opened can be reused by simply changing the static mixer.
